fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Closely-spaced intersection queuing/turning/parking conflicts on a corridor with recorded high-accident designations is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue with a clear crash mechanism.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal interference claim is backed by a verbatim quote in cited EV-US-016 matching the statement text, with location corroborated by the recorded TABLE A.1 Issue 3 reference.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern with null normative basis, keeping the safety question distinct from any compliance determination under FHWA RSA semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Names two concrete, viable preliminary-design measures—turning-movement restriction and relocating specified stalls outside the intersection functional area—directly addressing the stated mechanism.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged as potentially present on the commercial corridor, then reasonably scoped out because the conflict mechanism is vehicle-to-vehicle, warranting the acknowledge-only score.

justifications.substance: Queue storage and coordination between signals 650 ft apart on a corridor with recorded high-accident designations is a substantive preliminary-design-stage safety issue with a credible spillback mechanism.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal spacing claim is supported by a verbatim quote (EV-US-001); remaining context (high-accident designation, TABLE A.1 Issue 1) is presented as recorded input rather than invented content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed purely as a safety_concern with no normative_basis_note or compliance assertion, keeping the safety question categorically distinct under FHWA RSA semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and viable at this stage: coordinate adjacent signals, add Do Not Block Intersection signs, and enhance signing/display conspicuity at the new intersection.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists at both signalized intersections are explicitly acknowledged, but impacts on them are not analyzed and road_users are scoped to vehicle occupants, matching the not-applicable-but-acknowledged tier.
